0022600122.text: The Miami Heat (0-2) host the Dallas Mavericks (1-1) in Miami's fourth game of the season. The Heat have lost their last two games and sit 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, two games back, while Dallas is 9th in the West, one game back in the Southwest, and riding a one-game winning streak. Six Mavericks are out: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams are tied 1-1 in the 2025-26 season series with no games yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
